thread:
Elaine (Partnerships): Quick check — we need a compact SLO + mapping rules for SI lead intake before Monday. SIs are pushing for auto-claims on net-new > $100k, and we need clear cooldown/ownership to stop ping-pong. What should the default rules be?
Omar (Sales Ops): Do we have an existing cooldown in config? I think the intake doc had 60 days but field reported duplicates last quarter.
Reva (SI PM): Recommend 90d cooldown. Also require domain match + CRM canonicalized account (no duplicates). Proposed matching: match_score >= 0.82 AND domain_in_crm = true. If not, flag for manual review.
Sam (PartnerOps): +1 on 90d. Also add escalation: if SI claim not acknowledged by Sales within 72h, auto-escalate to PartnerOps with a Slack ping and assign a temp owner. We'll add fields `si_claim_ts` and `si_claim_status` to the intake record.
Omar (Sales Ops): We should exclude marketplace-originated leads from auto-claims — marketplace ops should own those. Can we add a `lead_origin` tag?
Elaine (Partnerships): Yes — add `lead_origin` and default `excluded_origins = ["marketplace"]` for auto-claim. Also require SIs to attach `playbook_reference` and one-line `validated_industry` when claiming.
Reva (SI PM): Also: require minimum evidence for net-new > $100k: 1) buyer domain 2) estimated ARR field 3) contact >= 2 stakeholders. If any missing, auto-route to manual triage.
Sam (PartnerOps): Example intake CSV/record we'll implement:
```
account_id,account_name,lead_origin,si_name,si_claim_ts,si_claim_status,match_score,estimated_arr,contacts_count,playbook_reference
12345,Acme Corp,partner-referral,IntegratorX,2024-08-12T14:22:00Z,claimed,0.85,150000,3,PR-987
```
ops-bot: A playbook PR has been opened: https://go.redwood.ai/pr/partner-intake-slo (will add tests).
Omar (Sales Ops): Can the match_score be derived from domain + fingerprinter? We should surface the raw signals so sales can override with reason.
Reva (SI PM): Yes — surface signals: domain_match (bool), crm_parent_match (bool), similarity_score (0-1). Overrides need a mandatory `override_reason` and require manager sign-off for > $250k.
Elaine (Partnerships): Legal note — NDAs/data-sharing shouldn't block intake. NDAs are handled at deal stage. For any pre-sales sensitive requests, tag `sensitive=true` and route to Solutions Engineering.
Sam (PartnerOps): Rollout plan: canary to EMEA accounts first, 50 accounts, Tuesday 09:00 PST. PartnerOps will monitor two metrics for 48h: duplicate_claim_rate and time_to_ack. ops-bot will post daily summary.
Omar (Sales Ops): TL;DR for CRM update?
Elaine (Partnerships): TL;DR summary for CRM update: add fields (`lead_origin`, `si_claim_ts`, `si_claim_status`, `match_score`, `override_reason`, `playbook_reference`, `sensitive`), default auto-claim rules = net-new ARR >= 100k, match_score >= 0.82, cooldown = 90d, excluded_origins = ["marketplace"], auto-escalate after 72h. Manager sign-off required for overrides > 250k.
Reva (SI PM): Sounds good. I'll draft a short checklist for SI onboarding with these rules.
Sam (PartnerOps): I'll author the PR and schedule the canary. Will post link and quick checklist when done. :thumbsup:
Elaine (Partnerships): Awesome — thanks everyone. If no objections by EOD I'll merge the playbook and update the partner intake doc. :eyes:
